limitations: One 135M model, fixed pruning severity, one seed, four examples per split; this is a feasibility smoke, not a generalization or superiority claim.
Quality is next-token loss and perplexity on four held-out WikiText-2 test rows; selection uses the separate validation split.
Latency is short-batch prefill under observed workstation load; it is not a decode-throughput or deployment benchmark.
No distillation, multiple-precision, or CPU-offload arm is included.
Temporary candidate artifacts were reloaded for verification and are not retained by this script.

surgery.method: global lowest gated-MLP channel proxy: sum over layers of gate-row L2 norm x up-row L2 norm x down-column L2 norm
